translations.web: I will remember my covenant, which is between me and you and every living creature of all flesh, and the waters will no more become a flood to destroy all flesh.
translations.bsb: I will remember My covenant between Me and you and every living creature of every kind. Never again will the waters become a flood to destroy all life.
